servicesStatus: Suit cleaning and garment-care requests are assessed for garment suitability. Paid two-piece and three-piece suit-cleaning packages are described here; confirm other garment requests individually.
pricingStatus: Standard paid suit cleaning: two-piece 40,000 RWF; three-piece 50,000 RWF. Express: two-piece 54,000 RWF; three-piece 67,500 RWF. Confirm the complete quotation before payment.
turnaroundStatus: Standard paid suit cleaning usually takes 4–5 working days from collection to return delivery. Confirm the actual return date when accepting the order. Express return delivery is within two working days of collection, subject to availability; agree the exact return date before payment.
arrangementsStatus: Confirm collection and return locations, the transport service area and the complete quotation before payment. Do not assume nationwide included transport or a fixed outside-Kigali fee. Other garment types, including separate shirts and dresses, require an individually confirmed service and quotation.
